hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" || exit 0; command -v codex >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; [ -n "$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null)" ] || exit 0; codex exec -s danger-full-access "Review all changes since the last commit (git diff HEAD, plus any untracked files) and write feedback to planning/Review-commit.md" </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1
